records.failureSummary: Added store unit tests in test/store.test.mjs for store.update and store.remove under the existing node:test framework. Tests cover all 5 slice-1 acceptance criteria plus a list/create regression test: [AC-S1-1] partial updates (title-only, done-only, both), [AC-S1-2] patch absent fields not overwritten (id, done, other todos, empty patch), [AC-S1-3] update return value deep-equals the value read back from store.get/list, [AC-S1-4] miss on update/remove returns falsy without throwing and leaves data unchanged, [AC-S1-5] remove deletes only the target and keeps remaining items readable/appendable, [REG-list-create] existing list/add behavior unchanged. Red-first evidence: tests were run against the placeholder store (update/remove throwing) before/independent of the implementation, 10/11 failing with errors \"update/尚未实现\" and \"remove 尚未实现\" while the regression test passed; the temporary baseline harness was then deleted. Against the current implementation `npm run test` (package.json test script `node --test`) reports 13 tests, 13 pass, 0 fail, 0 errors. `npm run build` and `npm run lint` both exit 0. pnpm is not installed in the sandbox (pnpm: not found, exit 127), so the identical underlying command was invoked. No product code was modified; the only new workspace file is test/store.test.mjs.
